description: Record or withdraw ONE consent for ONE purpose on a lead or contact — the data the send gate reads. A consent is always for ONE purpose: whoever agreed to the newsletter did not agree to cold outreach, so there is one row per person and purpose and setting it again replaces that row. status 'revoked' is a withdrawal and is NEVER overridable by any role. Optional expires_at: after that date the consent stops counting even while the status still says 'granted' — an unrenewed consent is the most common way to treat an expired one as valid. Every change lands in the audit trail with old and new value.

channel.description: How it was given: verbal | written | web_form | email.

proof_url.description: Where the proof is. Without provenance a consent is worth little in a dispute.

purpose.description: The purpose, stored in the existing column consent_type. Common values in this system: recording, marketing, data_processing, sms — plus whatever the tenant uses in campaigns (akquise, newsletter, bestandskunde, terminabstimmung, vertrag, rechnung). Must match the purpose used when sending, or the consent will not be found.

name: set_consent
